name: Curse of the Wilds
body:
Every untamed land is home to wild things.

Bonus Spells: 0th—touch of fatigue, 1st—entangle, 2nd—eroding ray, 3rd—rusting grasp, 4th—insect plague

Curse Manifestation

The lathspell is constantly surrounded by the trappings of the wild world. The sound of distant wind in the trees, a faint breeze, the scent of moist earth. This aura is like that of an oncoming storm and unsettles animals. All creatures of the animal, elemental, plant, and vermin subtypes are considered to be one step more hostile when within 100 feet of the lathspell.

Curse Abilities
Call the Wild (Su)

You add all summon nature’s ally spells of 1st to 4th level to your spell list and spells known. Whenever you cast a summon nature’s ally spell to summon multiple creatures you add one to the number of creature’s summoned.

Ferocious Transformation (Su)

You add beast shape i as a 2nd-level spell, beast shape ii as a 3rd-level spell, and beast shape iii as a 4th-level spell on your spell list and list of spells known. You may use your cursed strike ability with the natural attacks of shapes you assume with these spells. You may also cast spells while under the effects of beast shape spells as though you possessed the Natural Spell feat.

Overgrowth (Su)

Whenever you cast a spell that creates or manipulates plant life such as entangle or wall of thorns it is treated as though it had the curse descriptor for the purposes of your class features.

Reclaim the Earth (Sp)

Requires 10th level

You can convince the very earth to become a wild thing.

You may cast move earth and transmute rock to mud each once per day using your caster level.

Storm Caller (Su)

Requires 10th level

You can bend the elements against friends and foes alike. As a full round action you may call on the wild world to begin raging. High winds and torrential rain begin within a 200 foot radius. This weather distracts spell casters, hampers vision, and may push or carry away creatures and objects. No creatures in the radius, including yourself, are excluded from the effect. This storm lasts for one minute then disappears as suddenly as it began. You may use this ability once per week.

Tap the Natural World (Su)

You may add one spell of each spell level 1st through 4th from the druid or ranger spell list to your spell list and spells known. You must still have the appropriate spell slot available to cast these spells. You may select this ability multiple times.

Untamed Companion (Sp)

Requires 6th level

You gain an animal companion as the ranger’s natural bond class feature, treating your lathspell level -3 as your druid level for the animal companions abilities.

You must choose an animal that is not typically kept as a pet or livestock such as a wolf or a large cat. This animal is not affected by your manifestation as it is an extension of your curse but appears wild or unfriendly to others and treats other creatures warily.

Wild Mind (Su)

You gain the ability to communicate with wild creatures. You may communicate with animals, elementals, plants, and vermin as though by the spell tongues. This grants you no special ability to influence these creatures, simply communicate with them, which does allow for the use of diplomacy and other skills.

Wracking Rot (Su)

Requires 10th level

You can, as one of your attacks during a round, impart an aspect of your wild curse as a touch attack that causes the target to be covered in rot and mold. They take penalties as though they had advanced one age category to Strength, Constitution, and Dexterity. This ability affects objects as though by a rusting grasp using your caster level. When targeting a creature this effect lasts for 1 minute per level and is ineffective against creatures and objects that cannot be rusted or aged, such as mithral. A successful Fortitude save negates this effect.

Wrapping Curse (Su)

Whenever you cast a spell with the curse descriptor that allows for a saving throw you may also choose to entangle the target, causing twisting vines to sprout at their feet and root them to the ground. This entangle effect lasts for one round per level of the curse spell cast. If the target successfully saved against the curse their movement speed is instead reduced by half until your next turn.

Walking Curse
Wild World (Su)

The height of your curse is to summon the wilderness into any bastion of civilization.

After one minute in concentration you may channel the power of your curse to wreak havoc on the created world. Cracks form in foundations and glass breaks within 100 feet of you. Wood, worked stone, and steel lose 10 hardness in the same radius and all animals, elementals, plants and vermin within 60 feet of you enter a rage as a barbarian of your class level and attack the nearest creature each turn. Any creature or object that is no longer in this radius at the start of your turn returns to normal. This effect lasts for one hour.
